svg.title: Engineering reference - source page 96
svg.desc: Indoor pool monitoring: server, cabinet, switch and DCS; circulation pump; heating and water-supply PI valves; ozone generator; aluminium-coagulant dosing pump; underwater/step lights; drain valve; level, return-temperature and online turbidity sensing; temperature display. Key: 系统服务器 = system server; 网络交换机 = network switch; 数据采集/处理模块 = data-acquisition/processing module; 设备控制柜 = control cabinet; 比例积分调节阀 = PI control valve; 液位变送器 = level transmitter; 温度变送器 = temperature transmitter; 压力变送器 = pressure transmitter; 电动两通阀 = motorised two-way valve; 水温显示屏 = temperature display; 臭氧发生器 = ozone generator; 计量投药泵 = dosing pump; 电磁流量计 = electromagnetic flow meter; 注水 = fill; 排水 = drain; 控温 = temperature control; 续费 = payment extension.
